note: City of Stromsburg campground on the north side of Buckley Park, along Prairie Creek near its confluence with the Big Blue River, just west of US 81. Twelve electric pedestals under large shade trees, four water hydrants, covered pavilion; primitive tent area at creek-bank level west of the pavilion. Walking trail to the town square. BNSF tracks adjacent. --Claude
summary: City page read: 12 electric pedestals (eight 50A, eleven 30A, eleven 20A outlets), four hydrants, dump station, donation only, 'busy year round'. Hookups, sites, fees now manual; dump, potable water and year-round added; flush toilets cleared (directories only). City phone and page found. Pin at the highway edge ~85 m E of the loop. Prairie Creek is narrow and tree-lined: not waterfront kept. Note cleaned.

WATER: 'not waterfront' kept. The city says the campground is 'along Prairie Creek', but on imagery the creek is a tree-covered channel well under 30 m wide (creekside at most), and no pad shows within a pad-depth of it under the canopy. The Big Blue is farther south. Default down.
